title: Steering System
text: Steering system for Ackermann and rack-and-pinion steering mechanisms, 10 inputs, 3 outputs; {Type} sets the steering type Rack, {Intermediate shaft type}, {Power assist} sets the option to model power assist, {Ackerman steering} sets the option to use Ackermann steering, {Kingpin moment} sets the left and right kingpin moments, {Steered axle} sets the location of steering, {Steering inputs} sets the steering wheel angle, {Track width, TrckWdth}, {Steering angle input range, StrRng} sets the steering wheel range, {Steering angle input deadband width, DbWdth}, {Steering wheel inertia, StrWhlInert}, {Steering shaft inertia, StrColInert} sets the inertia of steering shaft, {Kingpin offset, KngpnOfst}, {Kingpin inclination angle, Lambda}, {Hub lead, HbLead} sets the hub lead 4.00E-05, {Static loaded radius, StcLdRadius}, {Overall steering ratio, OvrlStrRatio}, {Steering angle breakpoints, StrgAngBpts} sets the steering wheel angle breakpoints, {CstrAng} sets the caster angle, {Rack gain parameterized by} sets the rack gain parameterization, {Rack gain, RckGn}, {Rack gain table, RckGnTbl} sets the rack gain table ones, {Steering arm length, StrgArmLngth}, {Rack casing length, RckCsLngth} sets the rack length, {Tie rod length, TieRodLngth}, {Distance between axis and rack, Dst} sets the distance between axle and rack, {Efficiency of gears, Epsilon}, {Pinion inertia, PnInert}, {Spatial angle for the single Cardan joint, SptlAng}, {Spatial angle for the upper Cardan joint, Alpha_b} sets the spatial angle for upper Cardan joint, {Spatial angle for the lower Cardan joint, Alpha_c} sets the spatial angle for lower Cardan joint, {Edge view angle between the planes of the two joints, Sigma_bc} sets the edge view angle between planes of the two, {Phase angle, Gamma}, {Steering wheel torque breakpoints, TrqBpts} sets the steering wheel torque breakpoints, {Vehicle speed breakpoints, VehSpdBpts} sets the vehicle speed breakpoints, {Assisting torque table, TrqTbl} sets the torque assist table, {Assisting torque limit, TrqLmt} sets the torque assist limit, {Assisting power limit, PwrLmt} sets the assist power limit, {Assisting torque efficiency, Eta} sets the torque assist efficiency, {Cutoff frequency, CutOmege [rad/s]}, {Percent Ackerman parameterized by} sets the ackermann parameterization, {Percent Ackerman, PctAck} sets the percent Ackermann, {Percent Ackerman table, PctAckTbl} sets the percent Ackermann table ones, {Sealing stiffness, SlgStf} sets the sealing stiffness 1.5e4, {Upper boundary friction, UpprFric}, {Pressure change due to friction boundary increase, PrsFric}, {Maxwell element stiffness, MaxStf}, {Maxwell element upper boundary friction, MaxUpprFric}, {Maxwell linear damping coefficient, MaxDamp}, {Torsion bar stiffness coefficient, TorStf} sets the torsional stiffness of steering shaft, {Torsion bar damping coefficient, TorDamp} sets the torsional viscous damping in steering, {Integral anti-windup gain, A []}, {Derivative gain, D []}, {Integral gain, I []}, {Steering torque output saturation lower limit, OutSatLowLmt [Nm]} sets the output saturation lower limit, {Steering torque output saturation upper limit, OutSatUpLmt [Nm]} and {Proportional gain, P []}. Values come from the instance.
